note: Agriculture information site: agricultural news, a farm product catalogue and a weather forecast are open to everyone; an admin manages all three. The weather forecast is seeded rows for one fixed region (Green Valley County) — there is no geolocation or external weather API, stated here rather than faked.

NewsArticle.title: Wheat yields expected to rise this harvest
NewsArticle.summary: Favourable spring rains lift the outlook for cereal growers.
NewsArticle.body: Agronomists across Green Valley County report stronger-than-average tillering after a wet spring, with regional wheat yields projected to rise 8% over last year.

NewsArticle.title: New drip-irrigation subsidy opens for applications
NewsArticle.summary: Growers can now apply for cost-sharing on water-efficient irrigation.
NewsArticle.body: The county agriculture office opened applications for a subsidy covering up to 40% of drip-irrigation installation costs for row-crop farms.

NewsArticle.title: Dairy prices firm on strong export demand
NewsArticle.summary: Wholesale milk prices climbed for a third straight month.
NewsArticle.body: Wholesale milk prices rose again this month as export orders from overseas processors kept demand ahead of the seasonal flush in supply.

NewsArticle.title: Drone-based crop scouting gains ground with local growers
NewsArticle.summary: More farms are pairing multispectral drones with soil sensors.
NewsArticle.body: A growing number of Green Valley farms are combining multispectral drone imagery with in-field soil sensors to catch nutrient stress weeks earlier than a visual walk-through.

NewsArticle.title: Cattle producers watch feed costs ahead of winter
NewsArticle.summary: Hay prices are up on tighter regional supply.
NewsArticle.body: Cattle producers are locking in hay contracts earlier than usual this year as a dry second cutting tightened regional supply ahead of winter feeding.
